description: Header file for compile-time string formatting in the fmt library, defining classes, templates, and functions for efficient format string compilation and formatting.

classes.name: compiled_string
classes.description: A class representing a compile-time formatted string.

classes.name: udl_compiled_string
classes.description: Template struct for user-defined literal to create compiled strings.

classes.name: text
classes.description: Represents a text segment for formatting.

classes.name: code_unit
classes.description: Represents a single character code unit for formatting.

classes.name: runtime_named_field
classes.description: Represents a named argument field for runtime formatting.

classes.name: spec_field
classes.description: Represents a formatted argument with specifications.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first argument from a parameter pack.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the Nth argument from a parameter pack.

methods.name: get_type_impl
methods.description: Helper template to get argument type.

methods.name: is_compiled_format
methods.description: Type trait to check if a type is a compiled format.

methods.name: make_text
methods.description: Creates a text segment from a string view.

methods.name: parse_tail
methods.description: Parses the tail of a format string.

methods.name: compile_format_string
methods.description: Compiles a format string into a format component.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles a format string into a format component.
